item.title: Stephen Graham Jones: a good spine-tingler depends on its ending
item.description: Horror writer Stephen Graham Jones says the genre's current popularity is driven by more than fear alone.

item.title: Israelis have changed. Will their leadership change too?
item.description: Israel holds a general election this week after years of war. For many Israelis shaken by the Oct. 7, 2023, attacks and prolonged conflict, it is a pivotal moment.

item.title: College of Magic teaches ordinary kids to become skilled magicians
item.description: Students, many from marginalized communities, learn to conjure candy and perform card tricks while building confidence, creativity and resilience.

item.title: Blanche defends DOJ suit to block Alaska Senate results if Republican loses
item.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche defended the Justice Department's lawsuit over Alaska's Senate race in a CNN interview.
